{{Quote|I don't like the looks of this, Sergeant!"<br />"Shut up and shoot them!|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] and battle droid sergeant's final words|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
A '''B1 battle droid sergeant''' was onboard the ''[[Devastation]]'' during the attacking of the Devastation. The droid was destroyed by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
